Post Text:
Hi everyone,
I am looking for a reliable sourcing and fulfillment agent based in China for a new premium football collectible project I am developing.

The product consists of a premium black presentation/display box containing a football jersey together with several memorabilia items (photo/card, match ticket replica, archive/conservation card, etc.).

I am looking for someone who can manage the project locally in China from sourcing to final shipment.

Specifically, I would need the agent to:

1. Find and negotiate with a suitable box manufacturer in China. I already have reference pictures, approximate dimensions and the design concept. I am open to using an existing box and customizing it if this significantly reduces MOQ and cost, rather than producing everything from scratch.

2. Receive and inspect samples/prototypes from the manufacturer and help me communicate any required modifications.

3. Once approved, receive and warehouse a larger quantity of empty boxes at your warehouse/fulfillment location.

4. Source or receive the other components required for each product (printed cards, photographs, ticket replicas, conservation records, internal inserts/foam, packaging materials, etc.). Some components may come from different suppliers.

5. Assemble each individual order according to precise instructions that I will provide: place the jersey and all memorabilia in their correct compartments, perform a basic QC check and prepare the finished product for shipment.

6. Store the inventory of boxes and components in China.

7. When I receive an order from a customer, I send you the order details and you pick, assemble, pack and ship that individual order directly from China to my customer, initially mainly in Italy/Europe and potentially worldwide.

8. Provide tracked shipping options, shipping costs and estimated delivery times for individual parcels.

The idea is therefore not simply sourcing a product from Alibaba. I am looking for a long-term partner who can act as my local sourcing + consolidation + assembly + QC + warehousing + fulfillment partner in China.

Initially, volumes will be relatively small because I am testing the market, but the objective is to scale if demand is validated. For this reason, I am particularly interested in someone comfortable working with a startup project and small initial MOQs, rather than requiring large volumes immediately.

I would like to understand:

? Where in China you are based

? Your experience with sourcing/custom packaging

? Whether you have your own warehouse

? Whether you can assemble/customize individual orders

? Your storage fees

? Your sourcing/agent fee

? Pick & pack / assembly fee per order

? Typical shipping cost to Italy/Europe

? Minimum order/volume requirements

? Whether you can provide photos/videos during QC and assembly

I can send product renders, box references, dimensions and a detailed explanation of the project privately.

Please contact me by DM if this is a service you already provide. I am looking for someone reliable for a long-term collaboration, not just a one-off purchase.
